subject: PO authorization token, invoice pulse, and volume discounting — procurement constraints
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mediacorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@mediacorp.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@mediacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood engagement — PO fields + discount gating questions

Karthik —

Thanks for the call this morning. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we issue a PO:

1) Do you require a single PO per legal entity, or can a single blanket PO cover multiple sub-entities?
2) What exact PO fields must be present for your AP team to accept invoices (PO#, BU code, project code, GL account)?
3) We have a standard 45-day invoice run (weekly pulse) — will Redwood be able to issue invoices on that cadence?
4) The SOW references a 10% volume discount after $250k ARR. Procurement needs to know whether that discount is conditional on PO metadata (i.e., must the PO include a specific commitment code) or if it's applied on Redwood's billing reconciliation behind the scenes.

Attached is our standard PO template (for reference). Please send back the minimal PO field list and any format constraints so we can move to PO issuance.

Thanks —
Liam
Procurement, Mediacorp

Attachment: Mediacorp_PO_Template.csv (csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mediacorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood engagement — PO fields + discount gating questions

Liam — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then specifics below:

- Blanket PO across sub-entities: acceptable if the PO lists the target legal entity and the BU mapping in a single PO reference (we need one canonical PO# tied to the entity receiving the service).
- Required PO fields: PO#, Entity name, BU code (optional but recommended), Billing contact email, Invoice remit-to address, and an "Invoice cadence" field if you want weekly pulses recorded.
- Invoice cadence: we can support weekly invoice pulses; we will align invoice dates to your requested run but need a stable PO# and remit address.
- Discount application: volume discounts are applied during our billing reconciliation. The discount eligibility is tied to cumulative billed volume under the deal_id (DEAL-8921). You do not need to include a special commitment code in the PO, but including a "Billing Program: DEAL-8921" memo line helps speed reconciliation.

I'll list the minimal machine-readable PO schema we need (this helps your AP upload to ERP):
- po_number
- legal_entity
- remit_to_email
- remit_to_address
- invoice_cadence (weekly|monthly)
- billing_contact
- account_reference (optional free text — recommended: DEAL-8921)

Vanessa / Marissa — flagging for any finance/compliance caveats (e.g., do we need a separate SOW signature per entity?).

Next steps: I'll attach our PO template and a short note you can pass to AP that maps their CSV columns to our required fields. If we get the PO with those fields this week we can start invoices on the 9/10 weekly run.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.csv, Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mediacorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood engagement — PO fields + discount gating questions

Hi Liam — thanks, that all looks fine from our side. A couple of operational notes:

1) Tax / billing entity: if Mediacorp needs invoices issued to more than one legal entity, we can accept multiple PO references but we require separate remit_to addresses and a separate PO# per legal entity. Combined blanket POs are OK only when the legal entity is explicitly listed per invoice line.

2) Net terms: Redwood standard for enterprise is net-30. If procurement requires net-45, we can accommodate but that will change discounting cadence. For example, volume discount thresholds are evaluated on recognized billing, so extending terms to net-45 shifts when thresholds are hit — this rarely affects initial crediting but can delay invoice-level rebate posting.

3) Weekly invoice pulse: to support weekly invoices we need your AP to accept our invoicing format (CSV + PDF invoice). We will push weekly invoice files to SFTP or a secure drive link. If Mediacorp requires EDI, that is an additional implementation with lead time.

We can include a memo field in the PO for DEAL-8921 and our billing team will pick it up. For immediate reconciliation, please include the DEAL number in the PO memo and copy accounts-payable@medicacorp.com on the PO submission.

Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@mediacorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@mediacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood engagement — PO fields + discount gating questions

Thanks Karthik/Vanessa. A couple follow-ups from AP: 

- They asked for a short mapping doc showing Redwood_PO_Template.csv column -> Mediacorp ERP field names (our upload will choke otherwise). Could you share that mapping?
- For the weekly invoice pulse, would Redwood accept a single PDF invoice per week that aggregates all clips and a supporting CSV for line detail? That's our preferred format.
- Regarding the discount: procurement confirms they prefer the discount tied to a PO memo code so Finance can automatically apply the vendor rebate in our ERP. Is Redwood willing to accept a memo code AND still do reconciliation if the memo is missing?

Sofia
AP Manager, Mediacorp

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@mediacorp.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mediacorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood engagement — PO fields + discount gating questions

Sofia — thanks. Answers below and what we'll provide by EOD today: 

- Mapping doc: attached (CSV column -> ERP field mapping) — this is a 1-page table that your ERP upload team can use.
- Weekly invoice format: yes, Redwood will provide one consolidated PDF invoice per week plus a supporting CSV with line item detail (usage by day, model, route). That matches your preference.
- Memo code and reconciliation: Redwood prefers the memo code (helps automate crediting in your ERP). That said, if the memo code is omitted we will still reconcile and apply discounts in our billing reconciliation cycle; however, that may require manual intervention and could delay the credit posting by one billing cycle. To avoid delays, please include "DEAL-8921" as the memo code in the PO.

Action items: 
- I'll upload the mapping doc and a brief AP handoff note to the Drive link and email your procurement mailbox with the Redwood_PO_Template.csv.
- Vanessa: can your team confirm net-45 acceptance and whether that changes the rebate timing explicitly (just a sentence we can forward)?

Thanks —
Karthik

Attachment: Redwood_PO_to_ERP_mapping.pdf (pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@mediacorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood engagement — PO fields + discount gating questions

Sofia — quick confirm for your AP team to forward to ERP: 

1) Redwood accepts net-45 for this engagement; we will honor the volume discount thresholds as specified in SOW.
2) Rebate timing: under net-45, quantity thresholds are evaluated on billed volume; rebates will be calculated in the next reconciliation cycle after threshold is hit and credited on the subsequent invoice run (may be one cycle later than net-30).

Note for AP: include "DEAL-8921" in the PO memo to enable automatic ERP tagging. If the memo is missing, Redwood will reconcile and credit but manual follow-up will be required.

I'll place a one-line confirmation in Drive and copy accounts-payable@medicacorp.com.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOW
